Execute a design against a backend and keep an audit trail

Source: R/run.R
msa_run.Rd

Runs every planned call of a design (or of one block of it), parses the responses and records a full audit trail: timestamp, model identifier, hash of the exact prompt, raw response, parsed value, latency and any error. Rows are appended to store as they arrive, so that an interrupted study can be resumed with resume = TRUE and no response is ever lost.

Usage

msa_run(
  design,
  backend,
  parse = parse_identity,
  block = NULL,
  store = NULL,
  resume = FALSE,
  delay = 0,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

design

An msa_design (see msa_design()).

backend

A backend function, see backends.

parse

A parser function, see parsers. Default keeps the raw text.

block

Optional block number(s) to run now; default runs all blocks.

store

Optional path. Ending in .sqlite or .db writes to an SQLite table runs (requires packages DBI and RSQLite); otherwise a CSV file is appended to.

resume

If TRUE and store exists, calls already present in the store (same block, item, prompt, model and rep) are skipped.

delay

Seconds to wait between calls (rate limits).

verbose

Print progress.

Value

A data.frame of class msa_runs with one row per call. Columns of items other than text (for example reference) are carried along.

Examples

truth <- c(v1 = 1.2, v2 = -0.4, v3 = 0.1)
lv <- c("Benign", "VUS", "Pathogenic")
d <- msa_design(c(v1 = "variant 1", v2 = "variant 2", v3 = "variant 3"),
                prompts = c(a = "Classify {text}.", b = "Tier for {text}?"),
                models = c("m1", "m2"), reps = 2, seed = 1)
bk <- backend_mock(truth, levels = lv, thresholds = c(-0.5, 0.5), seed = 2)
r <- msa_run(d, bk, parse = parse_choice(lv), verbose = FALSE)
head(r[, c("item_id", "prompt_id", "model_id", "rep", "value")])
#> LLM runs: 6 calls, 2 items, 2 prompt variants, 2 models, 0 block(s)
#>   missing values: 0
#>  item_id prompt_id model_id rep      value
#>       v1         a       m2   2 Pathogenic
#>       v1         b       m2   1 Pathogenic
#>       v1         a       m1   1 Pathogenic
#>       v1         a       m1   2 Pathogenic
#>       v2         a       m2   1        VUS
#>       v2         b       m1   2        VUS
